rows.title: WS3 — Buy, tear down and measure the donor headset
rows.note: Donor headset fully torn down. Its driver already plays cleanly from the ADAU1860 on Chris's bench (26 Oct, see Chris's W44 page). Chris is now assembling the donor components so they can be built into our printed H1 shells. A written record of the donor measurements is not published yet.

rows.title: WS1 — H1 Rev-C master assembly: final, fully dressed virtual headset
rows.note: Pillow adapter redesigned and printed to fit the right earcup. MAXSensorBLE board and battery mounted inside the cup on removable brackets, with ribbon clearance and an external USB-C opening (CAD 28 Oct). Trial assembly printed and fitted; a USB-C cable connects through the shell (photos 30 Oct). Strap spring-insert concept drawn. Open: CAD flags a clash with the unmeasured flex tail; retention, strap material and the full Rev-C release.

rows.title: WS4 — PPG proof-out in the foam earcup at the mastoid
rows.note: MAX86171 lane. Sensor housing redesigned and sewn onto the Logitech cushion; board measured for CAD. Finger/ear tests: no pulse with skin contact, the waveform only moves when the finger lifts (photos 07-08). HR app decoder fixed so a saturated channel no longer drops the good ones; build and self-tests pass, not yet tested live. No reliable HR at the mastoid yet; formal protocol not started.

rows.title: WS3 — Flight-representative H1 worn and working in the aircraft (1 Dec demo)
rows.note: No direct work this week. It depends on the demo H1 build (donor components being assembled by Chris) and the WS1 Rev-C assembly, which progressed.

rows.title: WS3 — Build the demo H1: donor internals in printed shells, passthrough audio proven
rows.note: Waiting for Chris to finish assembling the donor headset components; then they go into the printed shells. The WS1 adapter and board mounts are ready to receive them.

rows.title: WS2 — H1 manufacturing plan and full BOM
rows.note: Mould box designed and printed for the first clear-resin cover trial (27 Oct). Silicone and release agent ordered; silicone due 30 Oct, mould and cast planned 31 Oct-1 Nov. Sourcing firmer stretch webbing for the strap (Arcade Atlas as reference; SA lead Weavetech, no quote yet). Still open: costed BOM at qty 10/100, suppliers, lead times, Duran's sign-off.
